## Claim or component

Which release, source, rule or result is affected?

## Evidence

Provide a primary-source URL, edition/page, dataset provenance or independent numerical check.

## Reproduction

Give exact versions, commands and a synthetic minimal example when possible. Do not post private data or personal lifespan predictions.

## Expected impact

Is this a factual error, convention disagreement, implementation defect, new hypothesis or replication result? Were previous effects/outcomes visible when this change was proposed?
